xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes :

1 The consolidated and the standalone financial results for the three and six months ended 30 September 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and have been approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 12 October 2026. The statutory auditors have issued unmodified review report on these results.

2 The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 12 October 2026 has declared an interim dividend of INR 12 per share.

3 One-time impact of New Labour Codes : Effective 21 November 2025, The Government of India has consolidated multiple existing labour legislations into a unified framework comprising four Labour Codes collectively referred to as the ‘New Labour Codes’. Under Ind AS 19, changes to employee benefit plans arising from legislative amendments constitute a plan amendment, requiring recognition of past service cost immediately in the statement of profit and loss. The New Labour Codes resulted in estimated one time increase in provision for employee benefits of the Group and the Company of INR 956 crores and INR 948 crores (along with consequential tax benefit of INR 237 crores and INR 235 crores, resulting in decrease in profit after tax by INR 719 crores and INR 713 crores), respectively and the same was recognized as an employee benefit expense (exceptional item) in year ended 31 March 2026.

4 One-time impact of a material Bilateral Advance Pricing Agreement (BAPA) on Standalone financial results: During the year ended 31 March 2026, the Company concluded a Bilateral Advance Pricing Agreement (BAPA) with a tax authority in foreign jurisdiction covering certain prior financial years in relation to transaction with its wholly owned subsidiary.

Consequently, the Company recognised an incremental impact of INR 5,733 crores with consequential tax benefit of INR 1,317 crores for the period up to 31 March 2025. The net impact resulted in a decrease in profit after tax of INR 4,416 crores for the year ended 31 March 2026.

5 Profit (loss) excluding one-time impacts of New Labour Codes and material BAPA and related tax impact,
a. For the Group is INR 17,371 crores for the year ended 31 March 2026.
b. For the Company is INR 12,756 crores for the year ended 31 March 2026.

6. Decrease in tax expense for the three and six months ended 30 September 2026 is mainly due to benefit arising from certain capital assets acquired through business combinations, resolution of certain uncertain tax positions with the tax authorities and the transition to the new tax regime.

7.Update on acquisitions: During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Group consummated three acquisitions. These acquisitions enhance the Group’s technology, engineering, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence and telecommunications capabilities. The aggregate estimated purchase consideration of INR 3,635 crores has been preliminary allocated to net assets of INR 205 crores; identified intangible assets of INR 1,949 crores; and goodwill of INR 1,481 crores. The estimated purchase consideration and fair value of net assets acquired remain subject to final determination.

8. Financial results for all the periods presented have been prepared in accordance with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (as amended from time to time) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other recognised accounting practices and policies to the extent applicable.

9. As per Ind AS 108 'Operating Segments’, the Company has disclosed the segment information only as part of the consolidated financial results.

Cash flow notes:

1 The total amount of income taxes paid is INR 1,720 crores (30 September 2025 INR 1,184 crores, Previous year, INR 2,408 crores).
2 Cash and cash equivalents includes earmarked balances with banks of INR 26 crores (30 September 2025 INR 21 crores, Previous year, INR 22 crores).

Related party transaction notes:

1."0" and "(0)" are represent amount less than 0
2.Dividend paid is before TDS deduction
3.Long term employee benefits of Key management personnel Includes employee stock compensation expenses
4.Long term employee benefits of Key management personnel does not include post-employment benefits based on actuarial valuation as this is done for the company as a whole
5.Opening and closing balances of related parties are presented at closing exchange rates of the respective period, accordingly movement of balances may not tally due to exchange differences
6.Payment,receipts and applicable taxes against dues with related party not considered in the transactions
7.Transactions related to Sale or purchase of goods and services are covered under omnibus approval taken from audit committee
8.Value of related party transaction approved by audit committee with more than 12 months service period has been reported as multi-year related party transaction
9.The transactions between the Company & its wholly owned subsidiaries and the transactions between two wholly owned subsidiaries are exempt under the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and therefore the approvals status has been stated as ‘Not Applicable’.
